title: 美国威士忌协会CEO：加拿大市场骤降70%，行业急盼重开大门
speaker: Michael Valelo

segments.en: Yeah, good morning. Thanks for having me.
Obviously, we didn't get the breakthrough. We were all hoping for this morning. So for American whiskey producers, this remains unfinished business.
segments.zh: 显然，今早我们期待的突破没有出现。对美国威士忌生产商来说，这仍是未竟之事。

segments.en: As you pointed out for a year and a half now, American whiskey has all been basically shut out for most of the provinces in Canada.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，一年半以来，美国威士忌在加拿大大部分省份基本被拒之门外。

segments.en: And this is something that affects the entire American whiskey supply chain. So not just the distillers, but all the way down to the coopers and also the grain farmers.
segments.zh: 这影响了整个美国威士忌供应链，不仅是酿酒商，还包括制桶商和谷物种植户。

segments.en: So obviously, we're hoping for a breakthrough. We're hoping for a deal. We're hoping to regain access to the Canadian market.
segments.zh: 所以我们期待突破，期待达成协议，期待重新进入加拿大市场。

segments.en: Then we were hoping that the provinces would align with the federal government and allow us to have access to the shelves. And we were really looking forward to reconnecting with our Canadian consumer.
segments.zh: 我们还希望各省能与联邦政府保持一致，允许我们的产品上架。我们非常期待与加拿大消费者重新建立联系。

segments.en: But obviously, that's not happening. How big of a part of the business is this that you're losing, either in a percentage or a dollar amount?
segments.zh: 但显然这没有发生。你们损失的业务有多大？是百分比还是金额？

segments.en: Well, I'll point to the White House figures that were shared.
segments.zh: 我引用白宫公布的数据。

segments.en: So in 2024, when the provincial restrictions went in effect, you had a market that was about $203 million when you measured that from March of 2024 when it went to effect in December.
segments.zh: 2024年，当各省限制生效时，从3月到12月，市场规模约为2.03亿美元。

segments.en: When you look at the same year-over-year comparison, it was down to 60 million. So roughly a 70% decrease in U.S. Spirit exports to Canada.
segments.zh: 同比来看，降至6000万美元，美国烈酒对加拿大出口下降了约70%。
